freetype_properties.description: FreeType properties string for font rendering.

gtk_overlay_scrolling.description: Enable overlay scrolling. 0 disables it (always visible scrollbars).

gtk_backdrop.description: Restore disabled backdrop state for windows.

gtkm_insert_emoji.description: Restore disabled insert emoji menu item.

gtk_use_iec_units.description: Use IEC units (KiB, MiB) in open/save dialogs.

gtk_progress_text_inside.description: Restore double text color for progress bars.

gtk_enlarge_scrollbar.description: Enlarges the active area for scroll bars.
